attacks.claim: The closed check runs before the existing-booking check. A member retrying a booking they already hold after the class starts gets 409 class_closed instead of the existing booking. This is a defensible design choice but is inconsistent with the idempotent double-submit behavior.
attacks.evidence: if (cls.rows[0].closed) return { kind: 'closed' }; appears before if (mine.rows.length > 0) return { kind: 'booked', ... created: false }

attacks.claim: The duplicate-booking 200 and the new 409 class_closed change the API contract. The route test covers only the 201 path, so the 200 status has no HTTP-level regression test.
attacks.evidence: return res.status(result.created ? 201 : 200).json({ bookingId: result.bookingId }); the only route test for success expects 201
